name: mrskwiw-plugins
description: Agent tooling by mrskwiw / knot0 — web QA, web replication, novel writing, spec pressure-testing, and a persistent REPL scratchpad.

plugins.name: web-qa
plugins.description: AI-assisted web-application QA: enters a web app as a real user, drives a headless browser through end-to-end journeys, captures evidence (DOM, console, network, screenshot), applies deterministic gates, and judges whether the user's goal was actually achieved — catching bugs that pass every objective check but are still wrong. Also audits accessibility (WCAG / screen-reader / keyboard) for assistive-tech users.

plugins.name: web-replicate
plugins.description: Reconstruction-grade documentation of a web app so it can be REBUILT: drives every user journey in a headless browser, captures markup/assets/traffic and design tokens (palette, fonts, spacing), infers the backend contract (endpoints, shapes, auth), and writes a rebuild blueprint. Sibling of web-qa.

plugins.name: web-drive
plugins.description: Turns a live web app into a command-line tool an agent can operate: crawls the route graph, reconciles what each page claims against what navigation proves, verifies each candidate action by performing it, and generates a per-site CLI with named verbs, JSON output and real exit codes. Sibling of web-qa and web-replicate.

plugins.name: claude-novel-writer
plugins.description: AI-assisted novel writing for Claude Code — structure, consistency tracking, context assembly, and prose analysis.
